result.topic_en: Bare calculations on linear systems of differential equations with skew-symmetric coefficients (rotation-type equations dx/ds = cy - bz + p etc.), their characteristic equations and eigenvectors, together with trigonometric/exponential solution forms and some identities for partial derivatives of quantities a_{ι,ι'} with respect to s.
